# Temptation Token

> A weekly fan-voting game on Base (Ethereum L2, chain id 8453). Fans vote for creator
> profiles using the $TTS token. Each round closes on a fixed weekly schedule, picks a
> winner with Chainlink VRF, splits the pool onchain, and mints Trophy NFTs.
> Operated by Blockchain Entertainment LLC.

Everything below is verified against the deployed contracts and the production database
as of 2026-09-25. Figures that cannot be verified are marked as such rather than
estimated.

## How a round works
- A round runs Monday 00:00 ET to Sunday 23:59 ET. End times are pinned to a fixed UTC
  calendar anchor, so rounds do not drift week to week.
- Voting costs a minimum of 5 $TTS. No single profile may take more than 40% of a
  round's pool from one voter after the first vote.
- At close, Chainlink VRF selects the winning profile, weighted by votes received.
- The pool is the winning profile's votes only. It splits 35% to the top voter on that
  profile, 35% to the winning profile, 10% to the Polaris Project (anti-trafficking
  nonprofit), 20% to the house. Votes cast on losing profiles are burned.
- Three Trophy NFTs mint per settled round with votes: winner, top voter, house.
- A round with zero votes has no winner, no payout and no mint. That is the designed
  outcome, not a failure.

## What is live
- Web app at https://app.temptationtoken.io
- Telegram bot (@TTSGameBot) and channel (@temptationtoken)
- Android build; no iOS App Store listing (Apple guideline 1.2 excludes this format)
- Weekly rounds settling without human intervention
- Referral payouts, signup bonus, club partner program, admin dashboard

## What is not
- Staking contracts are deployed and the reward pool is funded, but the feature is
  gated off in every client. Anything you read describing staking rewards, APR or vote
  multipliers as available is describing design intent, not a live feature.
- No third-party security audit has been completed. Older marketing copy claiming a
  completed SolidProof audit is incorrect and is being retracted.

- Voting (TTSVotingV3d): 0x783b8cd80b586b723188c93ef94ee1beede617b4
- Keeper (TTSKeeper3): 0x363ce4960e3b459f5892587a37ae1ff2ed04442c
- Trophy NFT: 0x02DDd0e63DC2A5F66Fdb5a46F5981191959AC9A5
- Staking (proxy): 0x7848cceEb8613375D36BA3f50dD577B4E6BCfc0d
- Admin multisig (Gnosis Safe, 2-of-2): 0xeFb59d88179edC49bDA60B43249722Ea0DE6fB86
All are verifiable on https://basescan.org.

## Token facts
- Total supply 69,000,000,000 $TTS, fixed. There is no mint function and MINTER_ROLE
  has no members.
- A 1% transfer tax is hardcoded and permanent. Several operational addresses are
  tax-exempt, including the liquidity pool.
- This page states no token price and no expected return. $TTS is a game token, not an
  investment product.
